description: This file contains utility classes and methods for interacting with Databricks APIs, including environment validation, credential retrieval, and API base URL management.

classes.name: DatabricksException
classes.description: Custom exception class for Databricks-related errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: DatabricksBase
classes.description: Provides methods for managing Databricks API interactions, including environment validation and credential handling.

methods.name: _get_api_base
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL, attempting to use the databricks SDK if no URL is provided.

methods.name: _get_databricks_credentials
methods.description: Obtains API credentials and headers, either from provided parameters or by using the databricks SDK.

methods.name: databricks_validate_environment
methods.description: Validates the environment for Databricks API access, ensuring required credentials and URLs are set, and constructs the API URL accordingly.
